schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/pruna/v1/predictions/p-video-2`. The model is fixed by the route, so the body carries only Pruna's `input` object.

input.prompt: A single red maple leaf resting on a plain white background.

PrunaPVideo2Input.description: P-Video-2 generation parameters. The generation is billed per second of the finished video, measured from the returned file, at a rate set by `resolution` and `draft`. The safety filter is always on; a `disable_safety_filter` value in the request is ignored.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio: 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3 or 1:1. Ignored when `image` is set.

audio.description: Input audio URI to condition the generation (flac, mp3 or wav). The output length follows the audio.

draft.description: Faster, lower-quality preview, billed at the draft rate.

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds (1-20). When omitted the model chooses the length from the prompt, up to 20 seconds. Ignored when `audio` is set.

image.description: Input image URI for image-to-video (jpg, jpeg, png or webp).

last_frame_image.description: Reference image URI for the last frame.

prompt_upsampling.description: Rewrite the prompt before generation. Disable it when a `seed` must reproduce a result.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Random when omitted.
